faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Cappadocia transfer and taxi service.

vipFaq.q1: What's the difference between VIP transfer and regular transfer?
vipFaq.a1: VIP transfer includes luxury vehicles like Mercedes Vito, personal meet & greet, flight tracking, and door-to-door service. Our vehicles are air-conditioned, spacious, and comfortable.
vipFaq.q2: How will I be met at the airport?
vipFaq.a2: Our driver will wait at the arrivals terminal with a sign showing your name. We track your flight even if it's delayed.
vipFaq.q3: What size vehicles do you have?
vipFaq.a3: We use sedans for 1-3 passengers and Mercedes Vito minibus for 4-8 passengers. For larger groups, we can arrange minibuses.
vipFaq.q4: Is luggage included in the price?
vipFaq.a4: Yes, standard luggage is included. Just let us know in advance if you have extra large bags or special equipment.
vipFaq.a5: You can pay by cash (TRY, EUR, USD) or credit card. Payment is collected at the end of the journey in the vehicle.
vipFaq.q6: How can I cancel my reservation?
vipFaq.a6: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. Just contact us via WhatsApp or phone.
vipFaq.a7: Yes, we provide free child seats. Just mention it when booking.
vipFaq.q8: Do you have transfers for night flights?
vipFaq.a8: Yes, we operate 24/7. Our driver will be ready even for flights arriving at 3:00 AM.

urgupTaksi.title: Ürgüp Taxi | 24/7 Taxi & Transfer – Göreme Taksi
urgupTaksi.description: 24/7 taxi and transfer service in Ürgüp. Hotel, terminal, airport transfers. Fast, reliable and professional taxi service.
urgupTaksi.intro: We provide 24/7 uninterrupted taxi and transfer service in Ürgüp. We ensure safe and comfortable transportation from your hotels to airports, from terminal points to all parts of Cappadocia. We are at your service at every point in Ürgüp with our experienced drivers and modern vehicle fleet.
urgupTaksi.content:
Ürgüp is one of the most important tourism centers of Cappadocia and hosts thousands of visitors throughout the year. Therefore, reliable transportation service is of great importance. As Göreme Taksi, we provide 24/7 taxi service in Ürgüp. We provide fast and safe transfers from your hotels to airports, from terminal points to all points within the region.

To get taxi service in Ürgüp, you can contact us via WhatsApp or phone. Our drivers pick you up from your hotel door and take you to your desired point on time. We offer ideal solutions especially for airport transfers in the early morning hours or late at night.

We offer fixed price guarantee for transfers from Ürgüp Terminal or your hotels to Nevşehir Cappadocia Airport (NAV) and Kayseri Erkilet Airport (ASR). No extra charges for traffic or waiting times. Our vehicles are air-conditioned, clean and comfortable. We safely transport all your belongings with our vehicles with large luggage capacity.

Our regional taxi services extend from Ürgüp center to all Cappadocia region such as Göreme, Uçhisar, Avanos, Mustafapaşa and Ortahisar. You can get a fixed price quote regardless of short or long distance. No surprise fees, agreed price guarantee.

The most important point to pay attention to when getting taxi service in Ürgüp is reliability and timely service. As Göreme Taksi, we are confident in this regard. All our drivers are experienced, friendly and professional. You can easily communicate via WhatsApp and make your reservation instantly.
urgupTaksi.faq1Q: Is taxi service available 24/7 in Ürgüp?
urgupTaksi.faq1A: Yes, we provide 24/7 uninterrupted taxi service in Ürgüp. We are always at your service regardless of midnight, early morning hours or weekends. We especially serve airport transfers in the early hours or late at night.
urgupTaksi.faq2Q: How long does it take to transfer from Ürgüp Terminal to the airport?
urgupTaksi.faq2A: It takes approximately 30-40 minutes from Ürgüp Terminal to Nevşehir Cappadocia Airport (NAV), and approximately 60-70 minutes to Kayseri Erkilet Airport (ASR). These times may vary depending on traffic conditions, but our drivers pick you up on time according to your flight times.
urgupTaksi.faq3Q: How are taxi fares determined in Ürgüp?
urgupTaksi.faq3A: Taxi fares in Ürgüp are determined according to distance and route. We offer fixed price guarantee for airport transfers. Starting fare applies for short distances within the region. You can contact us via WhatsApp or phone for detailed pricing information.
urgupTaksi.faq4Q: Do you pick up from Ürgüp hotels?
urgupTaksi.faq4A: Yes, we provide door-to-door pickup service from all hotels in Ürgüp. Just specify your hotel address and meeting point. For hotels on narrow streets, pickup is made from the nearest access point.
urgupTaksi.faq5Q: How long does it take by taxi from Ürgüp to Göreme?
urgupTaksi.faq5A: It takes approximately 10-15 minutes by taxi from Ürgüp to Göreme. The distance is approximately 5-6 kilometers. You can contact us for a fixed price quote.
urgupTaksi.faq6A: Our standard vehicles can carry 2-3 large suitcases + carry-on luggage. If you have more luggage, let us know in advance and we will arrange a suitable vehicle. All our vehicles have a spacious luggage compartment.
urgupTaksi.faq7Q: How can I make a reservation?
urgupTaksi.faq7A: Contact us via WhatsApp or phone. Specify pickup location, destination, date, time and number of passengers. We confirm immediately and share driver information. No advance payment is required for reservation.
urgupTaksi.faq8A: Payment is collected at the start or end of the journey. You can pay by cash (TRY, EUR, USD) or credit card. There are no extra fees or hidden costs. We offer agreed price guarantee.
